title: Files and directories with `os`, efficient reading with `bufio`

videos.script: Lesson 17 said a file is a Reader and a Writer. This lesson opens real ones. {{notes}} First, the three ways in. Write a whole file, append to it, read it back. You see why the error from Close is worth checking, and why the permissions you ask for are not quite the ones you get. {{tree}} Then directories. Make a path of them, list one in order, and walk the standard library's own source. Last in that section, a root that refuses a name like dot dot slash. {{buffer}} Next, the same hundred thousand lines written twice. Through a buffer it is several times faster. Through a buffer nobody flushed, the end of the file is simply missing, and nothing says so. {{scan}} Last, reading line by line, and the one line too long that stops a Scanner quietly. {{close}} Lesson 19 turns these bytes into structured data with JSON.
